question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Distraught
solution:
The correct answer is: **Happy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Distraught"** means deeply upset and agitated; it refers to a state of extreme emotional disturbance or mental confusion. (बेचैन, व्याकुल)

 
 
• **Example:** She was distraught after hearing the news of her friend's accident.
 
 
 
• **"Happy"** means feeling or showing pleasure or contentment; it is a state of being joyful or cheerful, which is the opposite of being upset or agitated. (खुश)
 
 
• **Example:** He was happy to see his family after a long trip.
 
 
 
• Thus, the antonym of "distraught" is "happy".

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Happy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Curved** (मुड़ा हुआ): Having a rounded or bent shape.

 
 
• **Example:** The road ahead was curved and difficult to drive on.
 
 
 
• **New** (नया): Recently created, discovered, or introduced.
 
 
• **Example:** She bought a new dress for the party.
 
 
 
• **Sour** (खट्टा): Having an acidic taste; unpleasant or unfriendly in nature.
 
 
• **Example:** The lemon was too sour to eat.
